vuln.name: Elasticsearch Instance Exposed
vuln.description: An Elasticsearch node is reachable on its HTTP port (9200/9300) without authentication. The REST API exposes index contents, cluster state, and, on older versions, allows script execution through the search and update APIs.
vuln.impact: Unauthenticated read of all indexed data, and on versions prior to the script security changes, remote code execution via script injection. The cluster can also be damaged or wiped.
vuln.recommendation: Bind Elasticsearch to a private interface, enable security (XPack / RBAC, TLS), and never expose port 9200 to the internet. Place it behind a firewall or VPN.
